title: NPS Swasthya: Health Cover & Deductibles Explained
description: The PFRDA is developing "NPS Swasthya," a new pension product combining retirement savings with health insurance. This scheme aims to provide health cover ran.

faq.a: NPS Swasthya is a proposed new product by PFRDA that combines retirement savings with health insurance coverage, designed to offer a hybrid solution for long-term financial and health security.

faq.q: What kind of health cover will it provide?
faq.a: Reports suggest it will offer health insurance coverage ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹30 lakh, with specific details on plans and benefits to be announced.

faq.q: Will there be deductibles in NPS Swasthya?
faq.a: Yes, the scheme is expected to include deductibles, meaning subscribers will pay a certain initial amount of medical expenses before the insurance coverage becomes active.

faq.q: How will NPS Swasthya integrate with existing NPS accounts?
faq.a: While full details are pending, it is expected to offer options for existing NPS subscribers to either reallocate contributions or make additional contributions to avail the health benefits.

faq.q: Who is the target audience for NPS Swasthya?
faq.a: It is primarily aimed at individuals, especially those self-employed or in the unorganised sector, who need a comprehensive solution for both retirement planning and health insurance.

faq.q: When is NPS Swasthya expected to launch?
faq.a: PFRDA is currently conducting pilot tests, and a formal launch date is yet to be announced. It's advisable to monitor official PFRDA communications for updates.
